events.title: The 10 biggest startup investments in Sweden this year
events.title_zh: 今年瑞典规模最大的10笔创业投资
events.summary:
With Stockholm-based Lovable announcing a €343 million Series C this week, we decided to take a closer look at Sweden’s startup funding landscape in 2026 so far. Sweden has produced some of Europe’s largest startup funding announcements this year, with Stockholm-based companies accounting for much of the capital covered by EU-Startups. From HealthTech and AI […]
The post The 10 biggest startup investments in Sweden this year appeared first on EU-Startups.
events.summary_zh: 随着总部位于斯德哥尔摩的 Lovable 本周宣布获得3.43亿欧元 C 轮融资，我们决定进一步了解截至2026年瑞典的创业融资格局。今年瑞典公布了欧洲规模最大的几笔创业融资，其中 EU-Startups 报道的大部分资金流向了总部位于斯德哥尔摩的公司，涉及 HealthTech、AI 等领域。
events.subject: EU-Startups

events.title: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Data, Neolab, AI Infrastructure, Defense And AI Coding Lead

events.summary: Databricks is back raising another $5 billion, after it raised that amount just eight months ago. The largest fundings this week also went to an AI neolab, data center and electricity storage, defense, coding and biotech. Let’s take a look.
events.summary_zh: Databricks 再次筹集50亿美元，而就在8个月前它也筹集了同样的金额。本周规模最大的融资还流向了一家 AI Neolab、数据中心与电力存储、国防、编程和生物科技领域。让我们一起来看看。

events.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba

events.summary: Apple has reportedly trained a custom AI model for the China market alongside domestic tech giant Alibaba, a rare cross-border partnership that cuts across growing tensions between Beijing and Washington. The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company's support, Reuters reports, citing three unnamed people familiar with […]
events.summary_zh: 据报道，Apple 与中国科技巨头 Alibaba 合作，为中国市场训练了定制 AI 模型。这是一项罕见的跨境合作，也跨越了北京与华盛顿之间日益加剧的紧张关系。据 Reuters 援引三位知情人士报道，这款面向中国的 大语言模型由 Apple 与 Alibaba 合作开发，并在 Alibaba 的支持下完成训练。

events.title: Berlin’s AI InsurTech startup omni:us acquired by Dortmund’s adesso to embed AI into core insurance systems
events.title_zh: 柏林 AI InsurTech 初创公司 omni:us 被多特蒙德 adesso 收购，将 AI 嵌入核心保险系统
events.summary:
adesso, a Dortmund-based provider of insurance-specific software and technology solutions, has acquired omni:us, a Berlin-based startup specialising in AI-powered claims processing. The transaction combines adesso’s insurance and software expertise with omni:us’ AI technology. adesso also plans to progressively integrate omni:us technology into its core insurance platform, the in|sure Ecosphere. omni:us solutions will be further developed […]
The post Berlin’s AI InsurTech startup omni:us acquired by Dortmund’s adesso to embed AI into core insurance systems appeared first on EU-Startups.
events.summary_zh: 总部位于多特蒙德、提供保险专业软件和技术解决方案的 adesso，收购了专注于 AI 理赔处理的柏林初创公司 omni:us。此次交易将 adesso 的保险与软件专业知识同 omni:us 的 AI 技术结合起来。adesso 还计划逐步将 omni:us 的技术整合进其核心保险平台 in|sure Ecosphere，并进一步开发 omni:us 的解决方案。
